description: This source file implements functions for querying and managing thread-local GL and EGL state, including thread management, mutex handling, and process initialization/termination for the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Represents a thread in the EGL context management.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL or EGL context.

methods.name: AllocateCurrentThread
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new Thread object for the current thread.

methods.name: AllocateDebug
methods.description: Initializes the global Debug object if not already created.

methods.name: AllocateMutex
methods.description: Creates a global mutex for thread synchronization.

methods.name: GetGlobalMutex
methods.description: Returns a reference to the global mutex, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: GetCurrentThread
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread object, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: GetDebug
methods.description: Returns the global Debug object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: SetContextCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current context for a thread, managing global state for single or multi-threaded modes.

methods.name: DeallocateCurrentThread
methods.description: Deletes the thread object associated with the current thread.

methods.name: InitializeProcess
methods.description: Initializes process-wide resources like debug and mutex objects.

methods.name: TerminateProcess
methods.description: Cleans up process-wide resources before shutdown.
